Title: Retirement: Azure Maps Route APIs Version 1.0 to Be Retired on March 31, 2028

Body.Content:
The following Azure Maps Route APIs version 1.0 will be retired on March 31, 2028:

  • Get Route Directions 

  • Get Route Directions Batch 

  • Post Route Directions 

  • Post Route Direction Batch 

  • Post Route Directions Batch Sync 

  • Get Route Matrix 

  • Post Route Matrix 

  • Post Route Matrix Sync 

  • Get Route Range 


Please transition to Azure Maps Route APIs version 2025-01-01 by that date. From now to March 31, 2028, you can continue to use Azure Maps Route APIs version 1.0 without disruption. After March 31, 2028, Azure Maps Route APIs version 1.0 will no longer be available or supported, and API calls will fail. All other Azure Maps services are unaffected by this retirement announcement.

 

Required action 

 

To avoid service disruptions, please stop using Azure Maps Route APIs version 1.0 by March 31, 2028. We encourage you to transition to Azure Maps Route APIs version 2025-01-01 prior to the retirement date. Please review the migration instructions and transition before March 31, 2028.


Help and Support

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and need technical help, create a support request.
